overview_description.description:
Trucking is the backbone of the American economy, moving 70% of all freight. Truck drivers risk their lives by spending months away from their families to keep the American economy moving.

They are working to make trucks autonomous on the highway and remotely controlled by drivers for the first and last mile. Their trucks will make roads safer while giving drivers meaningful work close to their homes and families.
